proposals.rationale: Node concept in our model matches a forwarding domain; te-node is the counterpart's node object; both are structural within the topology; t.node contains edges/links and participates in topology containment.
Topology contains nodes and links; te-topology is the counterpart. The gloss/purpose align (single multi-layer domain described by a topology).
Link between two nodes maps to te-link; both describe a topological connection with termination behavior.
Link-termination-point is a node-edge point where a link ends; a termination-point concept in the other catalogue is the closest counterpart.
Transitional/adaptation link corresponds to a supporting-tp adaptation; both express an adaptation or cross-layer connection at a node.
Layer-protocol-qualifier maps to an OTN label in multiplex space; both express multiplexing/qualifying of a signal.
Connectivity-service realized by a tunnel; te-tunnel represents the service path used to realize that connectivity.
Node-rule-group corresponds to constraints/matrix-like structures governing port cross-connects; not a perfect one-to-one, but a plausible analogue in a matrix form.
Connection-end-point within a node aligns with tunnel-connection-endpoint as an endpoint construct within a node/tunnel context.
